messages:
jamal: repro steps — streaming session reconnect + toolcall truncated by client. observed double provisional->final charge.

jamal: steps:
1) open stream, send prompt
2) runtime emits toolcall
3) client loses connection ~200ms
4) reconnect with same session token, resume stream, server truncates toolcall output (client ack) and emits finalize
5) ledger shows provisional_stream_charge + finalize_toolcall_charge (both billed).

elaine: can you paste the runtime logs around the OTA session id?

jamal: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-12T14:22:10Z] session=ota-8f1 reconnect token=abc123 stream_state=resumed
[2026-03-12T14:22:10Z] toolcall id=tc-45 start
[2026-03-12T14:22:10Z] toolcall id=tc-45 truncated_by_client
[2026-03-12T14:22:10Z] provisional_charge ledger_id=prov-789 amount=0.002
[2026-03-12T14:22:10Z] finalize_toolcall ledger_id=final-790 amount=0.002
```

sam: hmm, looks like provisional_charge isn't getting reconciled when finalize happens if truncate flag set. The retry/fallback path treats a truncated finalize as a separate event and re-applies provisional credits. Probably due to toolcall_id namespace collision when resume occurs.

maria: from billing side this is definitely showing up in user complaints — customers see two line-items which look like duplicate charges. We need a short-term UI memo and a permanent fix.

natarajan: UX thought — can we show provisional entries grouped under a single "in-progress" row on route billing page with a single expandable finalization? That would reduce support noise while we fix ledger dedupe.

elaine: implementationally, we could add an idempotency key that includes (session_token, toolcall_id, stream_offset) and ensure the ledger finalize step references the provisional ledger entry id to atomically settle instead of creating a new charge.

sam: agree. Also think we should special-case truncated toolcall finalizes: if finalize occurs within X ms of provisional and has matching idempotency, treat as settlement, not new charge.

jamal: quick mitigation: set provisional visibility in console to collapsed by default and mark provisional as "pending" so customers less likely to confuse. Also add a telemetry tag: "stream_reconnect_truncation" to all related events.

maria: can we patch billing reconciliation to refund duplicates automatically if matching user/session/toolcall seen within 5s? low risk business decision? cc @finance

ops-bot: deploy v1.58 to canary: eng-runtime (billing-patch) completed :rocket:

elaine: i'm going to sketch the ledger patch and a small console UX PR. will open RFC with test cases (simulate reconnect+truncate flows).

jamal: awesome — leaving notes in the ticket. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
